import sys

def add_mod(x, y, md):
    x += y
    if x >= md:
        x -= md
    return x

def sum_n(n):
    return n * (n + 1) // 2

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, m, md = map(int, input)

    N = 500
    ch = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for i in range(m + 1):
        ch[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            ch[i][j] = add_mod(ch[i][j], ch[i - 1][j], md)
            ch[i][j] = add_mod(ch[i][j], ch[i - 1][j - 1], md)

    dp1_first = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp1_second = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp1_first[0] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            w = (dp1_first[j - 1] * dp1_first[i - j]) % md
            w = (w * ch[i - 1][j - 1]) % md
            temp_second = 0
            temp_second = add_mod(temp_second, (sum_n(j - 1) + sum_n(i - j)) * w % md, md)
            temp_second = add_mod(temp_second, (dp1_second[j - 1] * dp1_first[i - j]) % md * (i + 1) * ch[i - 1][j - 1] % md, md)
            temp_second = add_mod(temp_second, (dp1_first[j - 1] * dp1_second[i - j]) % md * (i + 1) * ch[i - 1][j - 1] % md, md)
            dp1_second[i] = add_mod(dp1_second[i], temp_second, md)
            dp1_first[i] = add_mod(dp1_first[i], w * (i + 1), md)

    # Initialize dp2 arrays
    # dp2[0] and dp2[1] are 2D arrays of size (n+1) x (m+1)
    dp2_first = [[[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
    dp2_second = [[[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]

    dp2_first[0][0][0] = 1
    dp2_first[1][0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            for ln in range(1, n - i + 1):
                # Update dp2[1][i+ln][j]
                dp2_first[1][i + ln][j] = add_mod(dp2_first[1][i + ln][j], dp2_first[0][i][j], md)
                dp2_second[1][i + ln][j] = add_mod(dp2_second[1][i + ln][j], dp2_second[0][i][j], md)

                # Update dp2[0][i+ln][j+ln]
                temp = (dp2_first[1][i][j] * dp1_first[ln]) % md
                temp = (temp * ch[j + ln][j]) % md
                dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln] = add_mod(dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln], temp, md)

                temp_sec = (dp2_first[1][i][j] * dp1_second[ln]) % md
                temp_sec = (temp_sec * ch[j + ln][j]) % md
                dp2_second[0][i + ln][j + ln] = add_mod(dp2_second[0][i + ln][j + ln], temp_sec, md)

                temp_sec2 = (dp2_second[1][i][j] * dp1_first[ln]) % md
                temp_sec2 = (temp_sec2 * ch[j + ln][j]) % md
                dp2_second[0][i + ln][j + ln] = add_mod(dp2_second[0][i + ln][j + ln], temp_sec2, md)

    answer = dp2_second[0][n][m]
    answer = add_mod(answer, dp2_second[1][n][m], md)
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
